summary: @servicetitan/contentful preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall lifecycle script (scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs") downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it to run a sibling file math_init.js — a 727KB single-line heavily obfuscated bundle with a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header, rotated constant-table string obfuscation (WV8StW shuffle over an n7gIxM numeric table), and hex-prefixed variable names. The package is advertised as a Contentful CMS helper and its dist/ tree is a plausible React/Contentful library, but setup.mjs and math_init.js are bolted-on unrelated components. Using an alternate runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated bundle at install time bypasses Node-focused inspection and yields arbitrary code execution on the installer host. The misleading filename `math_init.js` inside a Contentful package is cover-story naming. Publication under the @servicetitan npm scope for a package whose repository.url points at servicetitan/anvil-uikit-contrib is consistent with a scope-squat or a compromised maintainer publish.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
